title: Thompson Industrial Supply Company
description: tismco.com Thompson Industrial Supply Company (TISMCO) is an American industrial MRO distributor founded in 1980 in Houston, Texas, with 46 years of experience serving the oil and gas, petrochemical, marine and power generation sectors along the Gulf Coast. With approximately 50 to 120 employees and estimated revenue of 25 to 75 million dollars, it supplies welding equipment, abrasives, power tools, electrical supplies, PPE, bearings, valves, pumps and fasteners. The company operates from its Houston Ship Channel headquarters with regional coverage across Texas, Louisiana and Oklahoma. Its product portfolio spans over 10,000 industrial SKUs from major brands including Bosch, DeWalt, SKF and Airgas. Family-owned since founding, it serves refineries, drilling operations, shipyards and construction firms across the Gulf Coast industrial corridor. It positions itself as a full-service industrial partner offering technical consulting alongside product supply.
